title: Text contrast ratios of 4.5:1 and 3:1 for low vision
statement:
To ensure digital text is readable by users with low vision, a minimum contrast ratio of 4.5:1 is required for normal text, and 3:1 for large text.

Options:
- Maximum Accessibility: 7:1 Ratio (AAA) (fits: government, healthcare)
- Standard Compliance: 4.5:1 Ratio (AA) (fits: ecommerce, saas)
- Large Text / UI Elements: 3:1 Ratio (fits: headings, icons)
appliesWhen: Applies to: all digital products. Audience: general, seniors.

source.title: Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1
source.authors: World Wide Web Consortium (W3C); Accessibility Guidelines Working Group
